blocks.text: Carpet Removal Services in Port Perry, Ontario — The Tear-Out Handled, the Subfloor Ready

c: New flooring is exciting. Ripping out the old carpet is not — it’s dusty, heavy, full of hidden staples, and the rolled-up remains won’t fit in any car. That’s the part we take off your plate. Our fully insured Port Perry crew arrives at your home, walks the rooms with you, quotes one firm all-inclusive price for free, and then handles the entire job: cutting, rolling, pulling underpad, prying tack strips and hauling every scrap away — often within hours of your call.

blocks.text: Queen Street Century Homes to Lakeside Cottages — Port Perry Trusts Us With Its Floors

Port Perry's homes carry real history — Victorian houses in the heritage downtown, family homes in the newer streets above it, and cottages ringing Lake Scugog — and plenty of them still carry the broadloom to match. Live Junk Free has earned over 660 five-star Google reviews across Durham Region by doing tear-outs the right way: careful with the trim, honest with the price, and gone with every last staple bag before your flooring installer arrives.

items.title: The truck measures your price — not a stopwatch

blocks.text: Carpet is priced like everything else we haul: by the space it fills in our truck. One bedroom's worth of rolled broadloom is a small load with a small price; a whole-house tear-out fills more and costs accordingly. Hours worked and Port Perry addresses never enter the math.

items.title: We look before we quote — always in person

blocks.text: Carpet jobs hide surprises: double underpad, glued-down sections, stairs wrapped tighter than they look. A phone estimate can't see any of that, so we skip it. A crew member walks your actual rooms, checks the actual carpet, and writes a number you can trust.

items.title: One price buys the whole job

blocks.text: Tear-out labour, hauling, truck, fuel, disposal fees — a single figure, agreed before we start, covering all of it. If the underpad turns out to be glued or the stairs fight back, that's our problem, not a line on your invoice.

items.title: We leave a subfloor, not a mess

blocks.text: Anyone can carry out a roll of carpet. The value is in what's left behind: underpad up, tack strips pried, staples pulled on request, and the whole surface swept clean. When we drive off, your installer can start — no prep day required.

items.title: The quote is free and so is walking away

blocks.text: You're never committed until you say so. Like the number, and the crew starts cutting immediately. Don't, and we leave without charging a cent — no deposit taken, no pressure applied, no callbacks.

National chains fold royalty fees into every job. We're an independent local operation with none, which is why Port Perry tear-outs consistently come in 30–50% below franchise quotes for identical work.

Frequently Asked Questions About Carpet Removal in Port Perry, ON

items.q: Q: How is carpet removal priced in Port Perry?
a: A: By volume — how much space the rolled carpet, underpad and debris take up in our truck. Small loads start at $125, a single room sits at the low end, and whole-home jobs scale fairly from there. The exact price is confirmed in person, for free, before any cutting begins, and it never changes afterward.

items.q: Q: Do you pull the carpet up, or just haul away what I've already ripped out?
a: A: Both. Most Port Perry customers book the full tear-out — we cut, roll, pull the underpad, pry the tack strips and sweep the subfloor. But if you’ve already done the hard part yourself, we’re happy to simply load the rolls and go.

A: Yes, and they’re one of our most common requests. Straight runs, winders, fully wrapped staircases and stapled runners all come up cleanly — including in Port Perry’s older homes, where we work carefully around original wood treads and trim.

items.q: Q: My basement carpet got soaked — how fast can you get it out?
a: A: Fast is the whole point with wet carpet. Soaked broadloom and underpad start damaging the subfloor within days, so we prioritize these calls with same-day removal across Port Perry and the lake area whenever slots allow. Call +1 647 922 5865 and tell us it’s a water job.

items.q: Q: Will the subfloor be ready for my new flooring when you're done?
a: A: That’s the standard we work to. Underpad up, tack strips out, staples pulled on request and the surface swept — your installer walks into a room that’s ready, not a demolition site.
